purpose: Separate oracle consumption, adapter precision, and learning-rate stability after pilot-001 failure
base: Same frozen Qwen3.8-27B per-row-int8 research checkpoint and pinned software as pilot-001
actual_bank_size: 1 for atomic questions, 2 for composition; shuffled independently of answer order
comparison: pilot-001 versus run 1 tests removal of distractors; score both with the versioned ordered-value metric
run 1 versus run 2 tests FP32 trainable parameters and AdamW moments while retaining BF16 base activations
run 2 versus run 3 tests a tenfold lower learning rate
evaluation: All 110 held-out questions and seven arms after each fixed final step; no held-out checkpoint selection
scoring: EOS required; ordered exact values ignoring whitespace at semicolon boundaries; also report legacy string accuracy
counterfactual: Swap correct IDs for active same-category memories with different answers; score following the replacement values separately
controls: Native prompts identical to no-memory, no base gradients, initial exact logit parity, empty/disabled generation parity
stop: Stop study on any child process failure; no automatic retry or budget extension
limits: Single seed and narrow synthetic vocabulary; not production throughput or new-memory writer generalization
